resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Ukrainian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Ukrainian pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula-notation, circuit, thermal, and SI-unit defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Ukrainian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current example title used a bare infinitive that was less natural as an instruction.
evidence: The previous title was Знайти струм.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Обчислити струм.

findings.summary: The resistance example title used a bare infinitive rather than a calculation instruction.
evidence: The previous title was Знайти опір.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Обчислити опір.

findings.summary: The voltage example title used a less direct infinitive label.
evidence: The previous title was Знайти напругу.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Обчислити напругу.

findings.summary: The electrical-power paragraph called heat capacity thermal power and used vague safety wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph used теплової потужності та запасу.
findings.resolution: Corrected it to теплоємність and an explicit safety margin.

findings.summary: The Joule-power definition used a hyphen where Ukrainian technical typography uses a dash.
evidence: The previous bullet began P - потужність.
findings.resolution: Changed it to P — потужність у ватах (Вт).

findings.summary: The current definition used the Latin ampere symbol in Ukrainian text.
evidence: The previous bullet ended амперах (A).
findings.resolution: Changed the unit symbol to the Ukrainian Cyrillic А.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage heating statement used an awkward literal construction.
evidence: The previous bullet used зниження опору збільшує потужність нагріву.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with natural Ukrainian wording for reduced resistance.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description did not name charge and energy as conserved quantities.
evidence: The previous description referred generally to поведінку у вузлах and around loops.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation around closed loops.

findings.summary: The KVL formula translated the protected parallel-branch note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with a localized branch note.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected expression ending (parallel branches).

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph used less precise literal wording for voltage rises and drops.
evidence: The previous paragraph used a literal translation of voltage rises and drops.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Ukrainian circuit terminology and consistent polarity guidance.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell statement did not clearly express approximate addition.
evidence: The previous sentence said capacity and current increase approximately without the relationship.
findings.resolution: Clarified that capacity and available current approximately add.

findings.summary: The resistor-equation step used less direct wording than standard technical Ukrainian.
evidence: The previous step used a literal relation phrase.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as linking resistor voltage and current by V = I × R.

findings.summary: The TCR unit definition omitted conventional spacing around division.
evidence: The previous bullet used 1/°C and ppm/°C.
findings.resolution: Normalized the units to 1 / °C and ppm / °C.

findings.summary: The TCR limitation paragraph used a literal phrase for material changes and first-order estimates.
evidence: The previous paragraph used зміни матеріалу and a literal result comparison.
findings.resolution: Clarified changes in material properties and deviation from the first-order estimate.

findings.summary: The Q_dot definition used a less natural term for heat-transfer rate.
evidence: The previous bullet used загальна швидкість теплопередачі.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as the total rate of heat transfer in watts.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example omitted Ukrainian thousands grouping.
evidence: The previous formula rendered 5000 Вт/м².
findings.resolution: Changed it to 5 000 Вт/м².

findings.summary: The heat-flux conclusion omitted the density term and thousands grouping.
evidence: The previous conclusion used Середній тепловий потік становить 5000 Вт/м².
findings.resolution: Changed it to середня густина теплового потоку and 5 000 Вт/м².

findings.summary: The convection paragraph called h a surface coefficient and used a less precise radiation term.
evidence: The previous paragraph used поверхневий коефіцієнт and радіації.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the convection coefficient and radiation terminology.

findings.summary: The SI table heading called the entries common units instead of base units.
evidence: The previous heading was Загальноприйняті одиниці СІ.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Основні одиниці СІ.

findings.summary: The kilo prefix was translated as kilogram rather than kilo.
evidence: The previous prefix cell was кілограм.
findings.resolution: Changed it to кіло.

findings.summary: The nano prefix symbol was mistranslated as a Cyrillic pi-like letter.
evidence: The previous symbol cell was п.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the SI symbol н.

findings.summary: The inch conversion formula used localized prose labels instead of the protected expression.
evidence: The previous formula mixed translated unit labels with localized numbers.
findings.resolution: Restored 1 inch = 25.4 mm = 0.0254 m.

findings.summary: The foot conversion formula used localized prose labels instead of the protected expression.
evidence: The previous formula translated the foot and inch labels.
findings.resolution: Restored 1 foot = 12 inches = 0.3048 m.

findings.summary: The unit-check heading used a word meaning aggregate or unit rather than units.
evidence: The previous heading was Практичні перевірки агрегату.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Практична перевірка одиниць.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge heading used generic measuring systems instead of gauge systems.
evidence: The previous heading was Вимірювальні системи.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Системи калібрування.
